_comment: Cross-language E2E reconciliation vector (docs/protocol.md §3). Generated by the Flutter pinenacl codec (apps/mobile/lib/crypto/e2e.dart). The desktop's tweetnacl/libsodium secretbox MUST produce envelopeBase64 for the given key+nonce+plaintext, and both sides must open each other's envelopes. envelope = base64(nonce(24) || XSalsa20-Poly1305(plaintext, nonce, key)).
